reviews.title: Price
reviews.comment: The Peerless Assassin 120 SE V2 White delivers excellent cooling performance at a great value. Its sleek white design looks clean in modern PC builds. The dual-tower heatsink and two fans keep temperatures low, even under heavy use, while staying impressively quiet. Installation is simple with sturdy mounting hardware. Overall, it’s a reliable, efficient, and stylish air cooler that competes with more expensive options without sacrificing performance or noise levels.
reviews.author: Jordan Maignan

reviews.title: Cheap and good quality
reviews.comment: Incredible PC cooler! Noise is really soft, performance even in 100% is silenced. And so cheap for the cost of $35. Mounting was easy, just check first your tower size

reviews.title: Keeps my 9600x cool
reviews.comment: Got this to go on my 9600x and it is doing a great job at keeping it cool. Idle temps around 38C and no higher than 75C on the tdie while gaming ( 67 on the cores). It does cover my RAM which isn't the best since I got the RAM I did but ti keeps the CPU cool.
